_comment: keel hooks reference for Pi Agent. Pi's core does not expose a JSON hook registry like Claude Code or Codex; instead, hook-equivalent behavior is delivered by the TypeScript extension `keel-pi.ts` (auto-discovered from ~/.pi/agent/extensions/ or .pi/extensions/), which subscribes to Pi's ExtensionAPI events. This file documents that mapping so users can see what keel provides on Pi and how to trigger equivalent behavior manually via the keel CLI or MCP tools when the extension is not installed.

SessionStart.description: Loads the keel bootstrap skill, injects workspace digest, resolves memory scope, and self-heals the MCP registration at session start.
SessionStart.manualTrigger: Run `keel memory scope resolve --create-missing --refresh-system-map` at the start of your first prompt.
SessionStart.timing: Once per session, before first prompt

UserPromptSubmit.description: Restates the iron law research-first rules on every prompt and injects a short context brief (skill routing decision + pointers).
UserPromptSubmit.manualTrigger: The AGENTS.md file loaded at startup serves the same purpose — the iron law is always present in context.

PreToolUse.description: Two responsibilities: (1) Iron Law enforcement — blocks edit-class tools until the model has demonstrated reading behavior this session; (2) command rewrite — reroutes noisy shell commands through `keel run --` for output compaction.
PreToolUse.deliveredBy: keel-pi.ts on 'tool_call' (returns {block:true,reason} to deny, mutates event.input.command to reroute)
PreToolUse.keelCommand: keel bridge pre-tool-use --session <id> --cwd <dir> --tool <name> (gate state); keel bridge rewrite <cmd> (compaction)
PreToolUse.manualTrigger: Prefer `keel run -- <command>` or the MCP run_command tool for noisy shell commands.

PostToolUse.description: Records tool execution observations (tool name, call id, errors) for memory and learning.
PostToolUse.keelCommand: keel bridge observe --session <id> (JSON payload on stdin)
PostToolUse.manualTrigger: No manual trigger needed. Observations are recorded when using MCP tools.

PreCompact.description: Runs the keel learning checkpoint and refreshes the workspace SYSTEM_MAP before context compaction to preserve structural awareness.
PreCompact.manualTrigger: Before compaction, run: keel memory scope resolve --create-missing --refresh-system-map

PostCompact.description: Injects the post-compaction context (workspace digest + active work items) and triggers the learning checkpoint, so keel state survives compaction.
PostCompact.manualTrigger: After compaction, run: keel memory scope resolve --create-missing --refresh-system-map

Stop.description: Turn-end checkpoint — fires the reviewer-on-close reminder gate.
Stop.deliveredBy: (no direct Pi equivalent; PostToolBatch gate runs via the extension's tool_execution_end + session_compact handlers)
Stop.manualTrigger: Before finishing a code change, run: keel review pre-commit --format compact

SessionEnd.description: Runs the learning cycle (skill generation from behavior) and captures the session summary to memory; clears the session-start and Iron Law markers.
SessionEnd.manualTrigger: At session end, run: keel learn (the bridge handler does this automatically)

PostToolBatch.description: Injects a reviewer-on-close reminder before the next model turn (enforcement gate).
PostToolBatch.deliveredBy: (folded into the 'tool_execution_end' observation + the next 'input' context brief)
PostToolBatch.manualTrigger: Before finishing a code change, run: keel review pre-commit --format compact
PostToolBatch.timing: Before each next model turn after tool use

workflowCommands.description: keel workflow commands that Pi Agent users can run directly via bash or the MCP cli tool.
